title: Raw TxQueue mutators are publicly reachable, unsynchronized, and uncontracted
description: tx_queue.py:401-429 pop/confirm_transmitted, tx_queue.py:587-599 signal_all_pending, tx_queue.py:294/98 public push(return_reservation=True), and LinkLayer.tx_queue is a public field (link_layer.py:186). Any in-process component holding the link instance can (i) tx_queue.push(raw)+drain_tx_queue() to put unsigned frames on air bypassing signing; (ii) signal_all_pending(True) to fake on-air success while dropping every queued frame; (iii) pop()/confirm_transmitted() remove the head without resolving the attached reservation, hanging the awaiting send() caller forever; (iv) a directly-pushed reservation can strand if no later queue op runs (wait() has no timeout), and a drain cancelled mid-CAD-backoff (link_layer.py:1457) is the one exit that cleans only the caller's own reservation. No remote path reaches the queue (all LinkLayer-internal use is under _tx_lock); this is local-misuse hardening. Fix: privatize or owner-token-gate the raw mutators (mirror _replay_owner_token pattern), document the reservation-resolution contract, and clean unresolved reservations on the CAD-cancellation exit. Found by security+correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-9qpz.
